manifest.title: The ball stops rising. Gravity doesn’t stop.
manifest.summary: A ball is tossed straight up on a fixed height scale. A motion arrow shrinks, vanishes at the top and points down, while the gravity arrow never changes.
assumptions: Gravity fixed at 9.8 m/s^2, no air resistance, up is positive.
manifest.description: A ball rises from a launch mark on a fixed height scale. The blue motion arrow shortens, disappears at the top, then points down. The dashed gravity arrow stays the same and points down.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed, then press Play. Playback pauses at the top; press Play again to continue.

program.source: export function evaluate({inputs,time}){const g=9.8,u=inputs.launchSpeed;const T=2*u/g;const t=Math.min(Math.max(time,0),T);const ta=u/g;const h=u*t-g*t*t/2;const v=u-g*t;const hmax=5*5/(2*g);const y0=380,sc=300/hmax;const by=y0-h*sc-14;const x=300;const top=Math.abs(t-ta)<0.004;const st=top?'Still for an instant':(v>0?'Moving up':'Moving down');const o=[];o.push(...sdk.panel({x:20,y:30,w:600,h:380,title:'Toss',state:st,id:'lane.toss'}));o.push(sdk.line('guide',x-80,y0,x+80,y0,{role:'neutral'}));o.push(sdk.text('guide.t',x+90,y0+5,'Launch height',{role:'neutral'}));o.push(sdk.circle('ball.toss',x-14,by-14+14-14,28,{role:'observed'}));const cy=by;o.push(...sdk.vector('vec.v',{x:x-50,y:cy},{value:top?0:v,direction:'up'},{scale:30,minLength:12,label:'v',role:'input'}));o.push(...sdk.vector('vec.a',{x:x+50,y:cy},{value:-g,direction:'up'},{scale:6,label:'a',role:'warning'}));o.push(...sdk.callout(x+110,cy-20,[st,'Gravity pulls down'],{id:'callout.toss'}));return {frame:{width:640,height:420,objects:o,readouts:[{id:'motionState',value:st},{id:'gravityState',value:'Gravity pulls down'}]},quantities:{launchSpeed:u,gravity:g,apexTime:ta,apexHeight:u*u/(2*g),velocity:v,height:h}};}
